recording: Actual browser screen recording on isolated seeded accounts; English synthetic narration. No real personal data or plaintext keys recorded.

chapters.title: Dashboard
chapters.text: Your dashboard shows the next learning step, current progress and permitted work. Use the sidebar to open learning, approved knowledge, assessments and certificates. Switch language without changing your account permissions.
controls: What stands between you and Ready

chapters.title: My learning
chapters.text: Use the learning list to find assigned, active or completed courses. Open a course, continue its next available lesson and follow any prerequisites. Progress is stored against your own account.

chapters.title: Learning paths
chapters.text: Open an assigned learning path, check the required sequence and due dates, and continue the next available course. Locked items show their prerequisites.
controls: Required for your role: Front Desk Agent
Hotel Fundamentals — Front Desk · Hotel Fundamentals
Guest Experience — Service Recovery · Guest Experience

chapters.title: Knowledge
chapters.text: Search approved SOPs and knowledge in your permitted organisation and language. Open the document, check its version and read the procedure. Acknowledge only after you have read and understood it.

chapters.title: Assessments
chapters.text: Open an available assessment, read its instructions and submit your answers. Attempts and passing requirements are enforced on the server. Review the outcome before retrying if another attempt is allowed.

chapters.title: Competencies
chapters.text: Review your competency record, the required evidence and gaps. Arrange any practical assessment with an authorised assessor. A completed course is one part of the evidence.

chapters.title: Action plans
chapters.text: Create or update an action plan with an owner, due date and evidence. Submit it for review when ready, then follow the review comments and update the result.

chapters.title: Certificates
chapters.text: Review issued certificates and expiry dates. Open or download the permitted certificate and use its verification code to confirm its status. A revoked certificate no longer verifies as valid.
controls: Front Office Certification · 2 of 9 requirements met

chapters.title: AI assistant
chapters.text: Ask a focused question about approved operational knowledge. Review the cited sources. The assistant reports insufficient coverage when the approved library cannot support an answer.

chapters.title: Readiness
chapters.text: Review readiness requirements and supporting evidence. Investigate missing learning, practical criteria and operational actions before confirming readiness for a role or opening.

chapters.title: Opening readiness
chapters.text: Review readiness requirements and supporting evidence. Investigate missing learning, practical criteria and operational actions before confirming readiness for a role or opening.

chapters.title: Account security and personal mobile key
chapters.text: Manage your authenticator and recovery codes. Create a personal mobile API key using your current password and a second-factor code when enabled. Copy the key once into mobile Sign in. Revoke it here when no longer needed.

chapters.title: Notifications
chapters.text: Read your account notifications and follow their linked actions. Mark the items read through the supported controls. Mobile push delivery is a separate integration and is not demonstrated in this recording.

chapters.title: Profile and preferences
chapters.text: Review your account information, language and accessible property context. Change only the fields permitted by your role and keep your security settings current.
